comment: Scripted large-title collapse for fixtures/scenes/navbar_large.json (M10). Drag up from (187,420): pan slop 10pt, so applied travel = drag - 10. Capture 0.05 = expanded rest (large 34pt title). By 0.50 the drag moved 46pt (applied 36 -> collapse d=36): large title mid-slide/mid-fade, inline title fading in. By 0.90 travel 90 (d=80): collapsed past the zone, scroll-edge pocket engaging over the content sliding under the bar. Release at 1.00 decelerates and settles collapsed; 1.60 = settled inline state (compare with the navbar_inline golden look).
